strings.sw_subtitles_hint: Show the translation of what you hear (Num1)
strings.sw_voice_hint: Hold Num7 / Num8 and speak: the translation goes into the virtual microphone (Num6)
strings.model_error: Model failed to load, see livedub.log
strings.hotkeys_text:
Num1   subtitles on / off
Num2   subtitles to next monitor
Num3   show / hide original
Num4 / Num5   smaller / bigger text
Num6   voice mode on / off
Num7 / Num8 (hold)   speak, get translated voice
Num0   dubbing on / off
Num.   repeat last phrase
Num9   quit
strings.lang_ptt7: Hold Num7: translate my speech into
strings.lang_ptt8: Hold Num8: translate my speech into
strings.audio_passthrough: Pass my microphone through the cable
strings.audio_autostart: Start voice mode with the program
strings.audio_help: Voice mode needs VB-Cable. In the call app choose CABLE Output as the microphone.
strings.model_hint: Bigger is more accurate but heavier. The first start of a model downloads it (medium is about 1.5 GB). "small" is easier on the GPU in games.
strings.about_text: Live speech translation and dubbing for Windows. Open source (MIT).
strings.about_privacy: Speech recognition runs locally. Only text is sent online: to Google Translate (translation) and Microsoft Edge TTS (voice).
strings.tray_hidden: LiveDub keeps running in the tray.
strings.msg_voice_fail: Voice mode failed to start, see livedub.log
strings.msg_need_edge: Voice synthesis needs edge-tts: pip install edge-tts
strings.note_model_ready: Model loaded. Press Num1 to turn on subtitles.
strings.note_model_loading: The model is still loading, please wait...
strings.note_cable_missing: VB-Cable not found. Voice mode turned off.
strings.note_model_fail: Model failed to load, see livedub.log
strings.note_cable_play: VB-Cable not found, only you hear the translation.
strings.latency_hint: Fast = shorter phrases and less delay, but choppier translation. A bigger model is more accurate, not faster.
strings.upd_packs_fail: Could not update language packs (see livedub.log)
strings.upd_new: New version {v} is available, opening the page
strings.upd_hint: Language packs are small data files from GitHub; the program code is not changed.
